description: This PHP class defines the 'ReviewerRating' entity in a Human Resource Management System. It maps to the 'ohrm_reviewer_rating' database table and includes properties such as id, rating, comment, performanceReview, reviewer, and kpi, along with corresponding getter and setter methods. It utilizes Doctrine ORM annotations for object-relational mapping and a decorator trait.

classes.name: ReviewerRating
classes.description: Entity class representing reviewer ratings, mapped to the 'ohrm_reviewer_rating' table, with relationships to performance reviews, reviewers, and KPIs.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the reviewer rating.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the reviewer rating.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the comment associated with the rating.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the comment for the rating.

methods.name: getPerformanceReview
methods.description: Gets the associated performance review entity.

methods.name: setPerformanceReview
methods.description: Associates a performance review with this rating.

methods.name: setReviewer
methods.description: Associates a reviewer with this rating.

methods.name: setKpi
methods.description: Sets the KPI associated with this rating.
